role: The chunk persistence interface (implemented by AnvilChunkLoader): load a chunk from disk, save one, plus per-tick and flush hooks.
scope_reason: Chunk unload and reload round-trips blocks, entities, tile entities and pending ticks, which the whole-server replay observes. Deferred: native never writes save files; Java writes every checkpoint (product decision, not a gap for the GPU or the golden chain) (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).

members.name: loadChunk
members.note: From the in-memory region store during play; from .mca only at checkpoint start (region_load_chunk).

members.name: saveChunk
members.note: into the region store; the bytes are the oracle's

members.name: saveExtraData
members.note: Flushes the async writer; no game state.

notes: Gates not re-run for this record. The disk half is n/a (lane/idxworld): every save this game makes is the oracle's (a checkpoint's save, session.sh's Save and Quit through Java: AGENTS.md 'Playing a full game'), and the native engine reads what it wrote (region.c for the overworld's region files, the snapshot's saved chunks for DIM-1 and DIM1, structures.json, villages.nbt, worldinfo.nbt, player_server.nbt); writing those files natively is the deferred product work of the 2026-09-25 triage (SPEC.md NEXT, '11 deferred save-writing'; out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md, 'Deferred, not noise'). Within a session nothing reads a save back: an unloaded chunk waits whole in the in-memory region store (sr_store_chunk) with what writeChunkToNBT keeps of it (the entities it saves, in section order; the pending ticks relative to the world time), and a reload restores exactly that (the persist-* and play-reload recordings).
